# Third-party design references

This repository contains original implementation code. It does not copy the donor repositories wholesale.

The visual and interaction architecture was informed by:

- **satnaing/shadcn-admin**, MIT licence. Used as a reference for a restrained responsive admin shell, queue layout, command search and light-theme spacing.
- **assistant-ui/assistant-ui**, MIT licence. Used as a reference for accessible conversation, composer, retry and streaming-state patterns.

The CogniPal artwork is supplied by the project owner and is also available from:
`https://assets.jonathan-harris.online/CogniPal.jpg`
